pages.title: The Bloom
pages.text: Approach an ember-lit assimilation heart within sixteen blocks. The journal records contact, even if you have not crafted it yet.

pages.title: What remains
pages.text: Collect a dormant flake or a sample of refined assimilation essence.

pages.title: The threshold
pages.text: Use an expedition terminal. A deployed terminal is a promise that there is somewhere to come back to.

pages.title: Heartwood
pages.text: Step through an expedition portal and let the terminal issue your compass.

pages.title: Checkpoints
pages.text: Activate an expedition checkpoint. Merely walking past it does not settle the instrument.

pages.title: Sealed cargo
pages.text: Reach a recovery objective and receive the expedition's physical artifact.

pages.title: Hold the line
pages.text: Deploy a defense device by reaching a checkpoint with a defend-device objective.

pages.title: Blood assay
pages.text: Experience Bloom exposure, or draw a sample with a field assay kit.

pages.title: Awareness
pages.text: Endure an infected hunting party, or raise a dimension’s awareness to twenty-five.

pages.title: Extraction
pages.text: Complete a run by using its extraction marker after satisfying every required objective.

pages.title: The guardian
pages.text: Deploy into Heart of the Thicket after completing Deep Salvage. Reach the final checkpoint to awaken what guards the roots.

pages.title: After silence
pages.text: Stand in a dimension whose major threat has been defeated and whose campaign has been cleared.
